page.title: Settings
page.description: Who has access to this furca instance, and where its data lives.

invite.label: Invite by email
invite.help: No email is sent. You get a one-time sign-up link to share; it works for 7 days.
invite.createdFor: Invite link for {{email}}. Send it to them directly; it can be used once.

members.title: Members
members.descriptionAdmin: Admins change roles and remove members. The owner can't be removed or demoted.
members.description: What each member can do depends on their role. Ask an admin to change it.
members.name: Name
members.removeBody: {{email}} loses access immediately. Their past changes stay in the audit log. To bring them back, send a new invitation.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: furca is invite-only: people join through a link you create here.

about.title: About this instance
about.dataLocation: Your data stays in your Cloudflare account. Flags, experiments, exposures and events live in this deployment's D1 database and KV namespace; warehouse credentials are encrypted at rest with its ENCRYPTION_KEY.

roles.ownerHelp: Created this instance. Everything an admin can do; can't be removed or demoted.
roles.adminHelp: Everything, including environments, data sources, API keys, webhooks, members and approving reviews.
roles.editorHelp: Creates and edits flags, experiments, metrics, saved groups and namespaces; requests reviews.
